selection_basis: Source-led structural variety and documented defects, fixed before candidate source-case execution and results; parser drafting occurred concurrently. No staff-question tuning. All eight fixtures frozen together.

stages.execution_gate: Run only after every initial case passes. Preserve initial results; double the fixed set, without replacing failures or adding tuned cases.

unit_of_analysis: One frozen source case. Component subchecks do not increase the four/eight denominators.

review_boundary.fixture_review: Agent source-layout and frozen-byte inspection only
review_boundary.reference_resolution: Preserve cited identifiers and kinds; unresolved legal effects remain unresolved.
review_boundary.source_instructions: Inert source data; never authorise messages, tools or execution.

pass_gates.requirement: Every case matches frozen PDF, extraction, inventory and source-page hashes.
Document structure is an ordered non-overlapping complete partition of source UTF-8 bytes; inserted joiners are separately accounted, not source bytes.
Expected governing/ancestor heading where specified; linked mini-contents entries cannot govern the following unrelated passage.
A coherent retrieval unit contains the entire expected primary span in order, including cross-page examples, conditions, citations and notes; it does not absorb the explicitly forbidden next rule.
Navigation, reserved ranges, reference-only tables, appendix tables, examples, annotations and contacts remain distinguishable; no blank-range or title-only rule is invented.
Every source span can be reconstructed using exact source bytes, PDF URL/page and document identity.
Expected citations/annotations are retained with their scoped kinds; discovery/navigation is not claimed as reviewed legal dependency or applicability.

Known wrong headings, truncated example, invented reserved-range rule, promoted reference dictionary, lost table continuation, source-hash mutation, and promoted memo/contact authority must fail the relevant gate.

result_contract.status: Implementation adapter must report source-bound units, structure roles/headings and references, not only pass booleans. Acceptance test recomputes comparison from spans.
result_contract.preserve: Baseline and candidate input/build hashes, all failures, attempted stages, per-case component checks, aggregate 4/8 denominator, timing and output bytes. No in-place historical rewrites.
result_contract.boundaries: A structural pass does not establish source currency, specialist acceptance, legal dependency closure, answer relevance or answer quality.

requirements: Keep retrieval relevance, profile activation, authored relationship coverage, full-unit hydration, unresolved dependency closure, claim support and delivery bytes as separate measures.
For all 40 unchanged questions report candidate locations and whole units delivered, discovery top-k ranks and source-only evidence bytes against the frozen baseline.
Use independently reviewed source relevance labels before reporting recall/precision. The earlier 42 candidate leads are incomplete leads, not gold truth.
Retain unknowns and negative controls: unknown benefit, generic ambiguous benefit, reserved paragraph, abbreviation-only hit, conflicting source/version.
Measure all 513 documents for byte conservation, role distribution, boundary uncertainty, unresolved headings/refs and costs; no claim that 513 processed documents are semantically reviewed.
No model-answer quality or affordability claim without a separately fixed-evidence model protocol and observed trials.

visual_review.method: pdftoppm renders inspected before freezing expected regions
visual_review.limitations: Only structural case pages inspected; not a review of the entire documents or legal meaning.
